description: This file contains utility functions for lowering exported PyTorch programs to AOTInductor, including wrapping modules for input/output flattening, compiling with AOTInductor, and packaging for NativeRT with AOTI delegate.

classes.name: FlattenedModule
classes.description: A torch.nn.Module subclass that wraps an original module to flatten inputs and outputs for export.

methods.name: get_new_ep_with_flat_inputs_outputs
methods.description: Wraps an ExportedProgram with a module that flattens inputs and outputs.

methods.name: lower_exported_program
methods.description: Lowers an exported program to AOTInductor, compiles it, and creates a delegate exported program.

methods.name: package_nativert_with_aoti_delegate
methods.description: Packages a NativeRT archive with an AOTI delegate for execution.
